decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software is core to the firm's move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management and is cheap to maintain alongside the existing offer.
It overlaps with Product A and may eventually be merged, but software close to the core offer usually stays in the portfolio, serving existing installations.
The floating sludge extractor fits the firm's established wastewater machinery line and its project business with utilities, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
Control technology for water engineering machinery links the firm's hardware and automation offers and supports its integrated solution approach.
Flow measurement automation software is close to the core offer and supports the data-driven strategy; the missing website archives show no sign of withdrawal.
